title: Display the planning as DAG
body:
MLE Agent can plan the projects from data collection, processing, ..., to final evaluation. To enhance the understandability, It would be effective if we can display the planning as a DAG or table.

![screenshot-20240604-195953](https://github.com/MLSysOps/MLE-agent/assets/43229014/107f8670-6bac-4e3d-8f13-4d0bd7ddc982)
